title: App shell layout and responsive grid styles

claims.text: The #app rule lays out the shell as a two-column grid with the banner, primary navigation and main content, centered at var(--lin-content-max).
The .shell-toolbar rule styles the shared toolbar row, and the skip-link rule hides the skip link until focus with .skip-link:focus.
Media queries at 58rem, 30rem and 18rem collapse the grid to one column and reflow the primary navigation and toolbar for narrow viewports.
The .state-error and .state-completed rules color diagnostics with the error and success tokens, and .screen-readiness plus .action-outcome show when not hidden.

triggers: shell layout overflows on small screens
skip link not visible on focus

decision.rule: Change here when shell grid layout, toolbar styling, navigation styling or responsive breakpoints need to change.
decision.failure: The shell overflows or misaligns at a breakpoint, the skip link is unreachable, or the toolbar crowds the main region.

questions.q: Where is the #app grid defined and what are its columns?
Where should I change the breakpoint where navigation becomes a four-column grid?
Where can I debug why the skip link is not visible until focus?
